title: 数字与日期的听辨
goal: 辨认数字、号码、金额、时刻与日期，并核对它们对应的对象及单位。

points.label: 听辨数字、金额和连续号码
记录时刻与日期并核对单位

sources.title: 雅思 IELTS Academic：课表
sources.used: 听力课的内容、知识点与教学规格

body.p: 数字要和它所指的对象一起记。thirteen 和 thirty 数值不同，还可能分属人数和费用。连续号码逐位记下，不当作数量。

body.box:
There are thirteen guests. The meal costs thirty pounds per person.
Guests: 13 / Price per person: £30

body.p: 时刻是几点钟，时长是持续多久。日期要写出日和月。金额要核对小数，以及每人、每晚等单位。单价和总价不能混用。

body.box:
The appointment is at ten fifteen and lasts forty minutes.
Appointment time: 10:15 / Duration: 40 minutes

cards.title: 相近数字与连续号码
rows: -teen 和 -ty 词尾不同，再用所指对象核对。
听清词尾，开头相同不能作依据。
重音会随语境变化，要同时听词尾。
-teen 结尾有鼻音 n。连读时再用上下文核对。
zero seven two, one eight four → 072184
开头的零是号码的一部分，要写出来。
double 只重复紧随其后的一个数字。
号码语境中的 oh 可表示零。
six two, four eight, one five → 624815
停顿用于分组，不改变数字先后。

cards.title: 金额与小数
rows: It's thirteen pounds fifty per person.
pounds 后面的 fifty 是 50 便士，不是另加 £50。
The charge is thirty pounds and five pence.
The total is eight pounds seventy-five.
这是总价，不换算成每人的价格。
It's forty-two pounds ten per night.
per night 是每晚的价格，不是整个住宿的价格。

cards.title: 时刻与日期
rows: quarter past nine in the morning → 09:15
past 是过了九点一刻，不写成 08:45。
half past two in the afternoon → 14:30
afternoon 说明是下午。half past 是过了半小时。
quarter to six in the evening → 17:45
to 是差一刻到六点，不写成 18:15。
ten to eight in the morning → 07:50
是二月三日，不是三月二日。
月份在前，日期照样写成日加月。
twelfth 是 12，词形变了，数字不变。
thirtieth 与 thirteenth 不同，分别为 30 和 13。

body.box:
A: I'd like the price for a room on the thirteenth of March.
B: It's thirty pounds and fifty pence per person per night. Arrival is from quarter to five in the afternoon.
A: Could I leave a contact number? It's zero seven two, double four, six one.

Date: 13 March
Price: £30.50 per person per night
Earliest arrival: 16:45
Contact number: 0724461

body.p: thirteenth 是日期，thirty 是价格。per person per night 是每人每晚的价格，不是整间房的总价。quarter to five 是差一刻五点，即 16:45。
号码里的 double four 写成 44，开头的 zero 要保留。如果题面已给 £，空内只写 30.50。

lines.text: How many display stands are needed?
Fourteen. The hall has space for forty, but we only need fourteen.

items.stem: Stands needed: ___ . Write A NUMBER in digits.
items.why: we only need fourteen 明确需求是 14，40 是容量。

lines.text: What's the reference number for the repair?
Zero six, double two, eight nine. That's the reference, not the cost.

items.stem: Reference number: ___ . Write the digits without spaces.
items.why: Zero six, double two, eight nine 展开为 062289，重复的是数字 2。

lines.text: Is the fabric eight pounds fifty a metre?
It's eight pounds and five pence a metre. Eight fifty was the old price.

items.stem: Current price per metre: £___ . Write the amount in digits to two decimal places.
items.why: five pence 对应 .05，旧价 eight fifty 不再适用。

lines.text: The standard hamper is fifteen pounds, and the large hamper is fifty.
I'll order the standard one.

items.stem: What is the price of the chosen hamper?
items.why: standard one 对应 fifteen pounds，large hamper 对应 fifty。

lines.text: When does the locksmith's visit start?
At twenty past three in the afternoon. It should take twenty minutes.

items.stem: Visit start: ___ . Use digits in 24-hour HH:MM format.
items.why: twenty past three in the afternoon 是 15:20，twenty minutes 是时长。

lines.text: Is the costume collection on the twelfth of April?
No, April the twentieth. The twelfth is the fitting.

items.stem: Collection date: ___ . Write the day before the full month name, using ONE WORD AND A NUMBER.
items.why: April the twentieth 对应领取日期，twelfth 是试穿日期。

lines.text: The adult entry is eighteen pounds per person. The family ticket is forty.
We need two adult entries, not a family ticket.

items.stem: Which unit applies to the £18 price?
items.why: eighteen pounds per person 是每位成人的价格，即第三项。两位成人一共要付 36 镑。

lines.text: The coach leaves at quarter to eleven in the morning. Check-in opens at half past ten.
So check-in starts fifteen minutes before departure.

items.stem: Departure time: ___ . Use digits in 24-hour HH:MM format.
items.why: quarter to eleven 是 10:45，10:30 是签到开始时刻。

lines.text: Hello, I'm enquiring about the recording booth at the neighbourhood media centre. I need to make a short voice recording, and I'd like to check the charges before I arrange a visit.
The basic booth costs thirteen pounds fifty per hour. The larger studio is thirty pounds an hour, but that includes space for several musicians. Which would be suitable?
The basic booth will be enough. I just need a quiet space for one person. Can I come on the twenty-second of February?
Yes. There's an appointment at quarter past two in the afternoon. The morning slot at half past ten has already been taken.
I'll take the afternoon appointment. Is there a reference number I should bring?
Yes, it's zero eight, double six, one four. Please keep the leading zero when writing it down. The reference is separate from the room number.
Understood. I'll bring my notes and arrive a little before the appointment.
That's fine. The assistant will meet the visitor at reception and show the way to the booth.

items.stem: Booking reference: ___ . Write the digits without spaces.
items.why: zero eight, double six, one four 写成 086614。开头的零要保留，double six 写成 66。

items.stem: What is the hourly price of the basic booth?
items.why: thirteen pounds fifty 是 £13.50，即第三项。£30.00 是大录音室的价格。
quarter past two in the afternoon 是 14:15，half past ten 是已被占用的上午时段。

items.stem: Appointment date: ___ . Write ONE WORD AND A NUMBER, with the day before the full month name.
items.why: the twenty-second of February 对应 22 February；序数后缀也可保留。

lines.text: I'm organising transport for our local walking club and need to check the minibus booking. There will be eighteen passengers. I noticed eighty pounds on the earlier quotation and wasn't sure what it covered.
The eighty pounds is the vehicle charge for one day. Eighteen passengers is within its capacity. There's also a parking charge of four pounds and five pence, which is paid separately.
Thanks. The walk is on the thirtieth of September, not the thirteenth. Could the bus be ready at ten to nine in the morning?
Yes, that's possible. The driver will arrive at twenty past eight to inspect the vehicle, but passengers should use the agreed departure time.
That's clear. Will the eighty-pound charge apply to each passenger?
No, it's per vehicle per day. It doesn't increase with the number of passengers on this booking. The parking charge is still separate.
Then please confirm that arrangement for the thirtieth.
I've confirmed it. The invoice will show the vehicle charge and the separate parking amount on different lines.

items.stem: Parking charge: £___ . Write the amount in digits to two decimal places.
items.why: four pounds and five pence 对应 4.05，5 便士不是 .50。
There will be eighteen passengers 说明人数是 18，即第二项。80 是车辆费用。
per vehicle per day 说明是一辆车一天的费用，即第四项。停车费另付，所以第二项不对。

items.stem: Agreed departure time: ___ . Use digits in 24-hour HH:MM format.
items.why: ten to nine in the morning 是 08:50；twenty past eight 是司机检查车辆的时间。
